provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Government and leaders
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify leaders
The pupils should be able to show respect for leaders
Introduction:
We know our teachers and head teachers
Today we learn about other leaders
Content:
Our class has a class captain
Our school has a head teacher
Our state has a governor
Our country has a president
We show respect by saying good morning
We stand when leaders enter the room
We listen when leaders speak
Class activity:
Let's play leaders game
Point to our class captain
Point to our head teacher
Evaluation questions:
Who is the president of Nigeria
Who is the governor of our state
How do we show respect to leaders
Summary:
Leaders are important people we respect
We show respect with our words and actions

topics.title: Rules and laws
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to list rules at home
The pupils should be able to explain why rules are important
Introduction:
We follow rules in our classroom
Today we learn about rules everywhere
Content:
Rules help us stay safe
Rules help us be fair
At home we have rules like no playing with fire
At school we have rules like no running in the hall
Our country has laws like no stealing
We follow rules because they help us
Class activity:
Let's make our classroom rules together
We will write three rules on the board
Evaluation questions:
What is a rule at your home
Why do we need rules at school
What happens if there are no rules
Summary:
Rules keep us safe and happy
We all follow rules to live well together

topics.title: Voting fun
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to participate in voting
The pupils should be able to count votes
Introduction:
We choose our class captain with votes
Today we learn more about voting
Content:
Voting is when we choose something together
We raise our hand or put paper in a box
We count the votes to see who wins
In class we vote for games to play
We vote for who helps the teacher
Everyone gets one vote
Votes make things fair for everyone
Class activity:
Let's have a class vote
We will vote for our favorite fruit
We will count the votes together
Evaluation questions:
What is voting
How do we show our vote
Why do we count the votes
Summary:
Voting helps us choose together
Everyone's vote counts the same

topics.title: National symbols
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify national symbols
The pupils should be able to match symbols to their names
Introduction:
We see symbols every day
Today we learn about Nigeria's symbols
Content:
Our flag has green white green
The green stands for our forests
The white stands for peace
Our anthem is a song we sing together
Our coat of arms has an eagle and horses
Symbols show what our country stands for
We show respect to our symbols
Class activity:
Let's play symbol matching game
I will show a symbol
You will say its name
Evaluation questions:
What color is our flag
What does our coat of arms have
How do we show respect to our symbols
Summary:
National symbols represent our country
We love and respect our symbols

topics.title: Nigerian cultures
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name one cultural food
The pupils should be able to describe one cultural dress
Introduction:
Nigeria has many people groups
Today we learn about our cultures
Content:
We have different foods like jollof rice and pounded yam
We have different dresses like agbada and wrapper
We have different dances like etigho and suya dance
Culture is how we live and celebrate
We respect all cultures in Nigeria
Class activity:
Let's have culture show and tell
Bring something from your culture to show
Evaluation questions:
What is your favorite Nigerian food
Describe a cultural dress you know
How do we show respect to other cultures
Summary:
Nigeria has many rich cultures
We celebrate our diversity together

topics.title: Tourist places
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name one tourist place
The pupils should be able to say what they can see there
Introduction:\ Nigeria has beautiful places to visit
Today we learn about some tourist places
Content:
Zuma rock has a big face like a giant
Yankari has animals and hot springs
Obudu has cool mountains and waterfalls
Tourist places show Nigeria's beauty
We can learn about nature and animals
We can have fun with our families
Class activity:
Let's play where would I visit
I will name a place
You will say what you would do there
Evaluation questions:
Name one tourist place in Nigeria
What can you see at Yankari
Where would you like to visit and why
Summary:
Nigeria has many beautiful places
We can visit and learn about our country

topics.title: Honesty in public
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to return lost items
The pupils should be able to explain why honesty is important
Introduction:
Sometimes we find things that are not ours
Today we learn about being honest
Content:
Honesty means we tell the truth
When we find something lost we give it back
Lost and found box is where we keep lost items
If we keep something not ours it is stealing
We feel good when we are honest
Others trust us when we are honest
Class activity:
Let's be honest detectives
I will hide some items
We will find them and put in lost and found box
Evaluation questions:
What should you do if you find money
Why is honesty important
How do you feel when you are honest
Summary:
Honesty is telling the truth and returning lost things
We feel good when we are honest

topics.title: Environmental duty
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to sort trash
The pupils should be able to explain why clean environment is important
Introduction:
Our school should be clean
Today we learn how to keep it clean
Content:
We keep our environment clean by not littering
We sort trash into paper, plastic and food waste
We use bins for trash not the ground
Clean places help us stay healthy
Dirty places can make us sick
We can clean up our classroom and playground
Class activity:
Let's have a clean up day
We will sort trash into different bins
Evaluation questions:
Why should we keep our environment clean
How do we sort trash
What happens if we litter
Summary:
Clean environment keeps us healthy
We all help to keep our school clean

topics.title: Safety in the community
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify trusted adults
The pupils should be able to name safety places
Introduction:
We need to be safe in our community
Today we learn about safety helpers
Content:
Trusted adults help us stay safe
Police officers wear uniforms and help us
Teachers help us at school
Doctors and nurses help us when we are sick
Clinics and hospitals are safe places to go for help
We should not go with strangers
Class activity:
Let's identify safety helpers in our community
I will show pictures of helpers
You will say what they do
Evaluation questions:
Who are trusted adults in our community
Where can we go if we need help
What should we do if a stranger talks to us
Summary:
Trusted adults help us stay safe
We know where to go when we need help

topics.title: Revision and civic day
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to recite the pledge
The pupils should be able to sing the national anthem
Introduction:
We have learned about our country
Today we celebrate our civic knowledge
Content:
We recite the pledge with our right hand up
We sing the national anthem with pride
We celebrate our leaders and symbols
We remember our duties as good citizens
Civic day is when we celebrate Nigeria
Class activity:
Let's have a civic day celebration
We will recite pledge and sing anthem
We will give civic badges to good citizens
Evaluation questions:
What do we say in the pledge
What is our national anthem
Why do we celebrate civic day
Summary:
We love our country Nigeria
We are proud to be Nigerian citizens
